metadata.population_definition: earliest regular-season weekly_rosters snapshot; statuses ACT/DEV/RES/INA/EXE; position/team frozen before outcomes
metadata.composition_pipeline: src.projection.composition.compose_board - the same stage sequence src.projection.predict.project_season ships

composition_stage_coverage._curated_depth_chart: absent: src/depth_chart/starters_2025.csv does not exist. Curated membership, roles, formation roles and replacement-level rows are therefore unmeasurable on this fold.

coverage_limits: Week-1 contracted roster snapshot excludes August camp cuts.
Veterans without a source-season feature row remain in all_eligible and score as zero model points.

Composition/allocation is the shipped pipeline itself (composition.compose_board), run over artifacts refit on seasons <= source_season. See composition_stage_coverage for the per-stage active/degraded map.

STAGES THAT CANNOT BE MEASURED ON A HISTORICAL FOLD, and why: (a) curated depth-chart membership, roles, formation roles and reviewed usage-share priors - src/depth_chart/starters_<season>.csv is hand-researched and exists for 2026 only, so apply_curated_availability_override, apply_depth_chart_gating's curated branch, replacement-level rows for curated players neither model path reaches, and the LWR/RWR/SWR within-WR split all no-op; (b) dated status overrides (IR/PUP) - status_overrides_<season>.csv is likewise 2026-only; (c) elite residual correction - models/corrections.joblib is fit on residuals spanning the target season; (d) prediction intervals - models/interval_residuals.csv is fit by backtest.py across the target season. None of these are faked or silently skipped: each degrades to an explicit pass-through recorded in composition_stage_coverage.

Roster reassignment (reassign_team_changers) is not run: the target team comes from the frozen Week-1 roster, which is a stricter preseason source than the seasonal_rosters lookup the shipped path uses.
No Sleeper or other external projection is used.
